module_role: Full-sheet MI703 Air Ops/MTRACON dedicated-outdoor-air-handling-unit sequence context. This captures the written operating behavior and printed setpoints; it does not assign the reusable DOAH points list to undocumented field controller terminals.

visual_review.finding: MI703 was visually reviewed full page. It contains two columns of written DOAH operation, safeties, alarms and per-DOAH setpoints; no formal equipment-instance terminal-wiring schedule is present.

sequences.finding: Install DDC hardware for the sequence/points; modulating control is PI unless specified otherwise. Supply/exhaust fans and VFDs receive fire-alarm precedence and have integral hand-off-auto switches; hand runs continuously subject to safeties, off stops, and auto uses start/stop plus DDC speed control.

Scheduler input selects daytime occupied, 24/7 occupied or warm-up/cool-down. Proof/safety failure disables loops and commands the fan off until reset; printed proofs are supply/exhaust fan status and safeties include freezestat, high supply-duct pressure and supply-air smoke.

Daytime mode enables fans/loops at scheduled maximum airflows; 24/7 mode does so at scheduled minimum airflows; warm-up/cool-down disables DOAH-A2. The VFD capacity loop targets the relevant max/min supply and exhaust airflow, with zero output and closed dampers when disabled.

Cooling is enabled above DOAH discharge setpoint, with enthalpy-controlled energy-recovery-wheel bypass and CHW valve control. Heating is enabled below that setpoint; wheel/bypass behavior precedes HHW-valve modulation, with frost detection and entering-air pump logic.

When disabled below 40°F OA, the HHW valve maintains 40°F casing temperature and an inline circulator is energized; pressure relief uses differential airflow between outside-air and relief-air setpoints.

ESS/FACP shutdown disables the DOAH and closes applicable dampers. Chilled-water load shed disables listed units until the failed chiller is restored. MI703 prints process, maintenance and airflow/frost/humidity alarm conditions and per-unit setpoints.

source_limitations: The sheet specifies points by reference to a points schedule but does not print a field controller terminal assignment or a per-point owner/wiring schedule.
MI703 applies to Air Ops/MTRACON DOAH behavior as printed; it does not itself establish an installed point multiplier or merge Air Ops and MTRACON equipment identities.

assertions.expected: INSTALL DDC HARDWARE TO PERFORM THIS SEQUENCE OF OPERATION AND TO PROVIDE INPUTS AND OUTPUTS AS SPECIFIED AND SHOWN ON THE POINTS SCHEDULE. UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED, ALL MODULATING CONTROL SHALL BE PROPORTIONAL-INTEGRAL (PI) CONTROL.

DOAH SUPPLY FAN, DOAH EXHAUST FAN, AND VARIABLE FREQUENCY DRIVES (VFDs) SHALL ACCEPT A FIRE ALARM PANEL (FAP) SIGNAL THAT TAKES PRECEDENCE OVER ALL OTHER VFD INPUTS AND SWITCHES AND SHALL CAUSE THE VFDS TO DE-ENERGIZE THE SUPPLY AND EXHAUST FANS.
WITH THE H-O-A SWITCH IN AUTO POSITION, THE UNIT FANS SHALL RUN SUBJECT TO THE UNIT START/STOP SIGNAL (SF-SS/EF-SS) AND SAFETIES. FAN SPEED SHALL BE UNDER CONTROL OF THE DDC HARDWARE.

THE SYSTEM SHALL OBTAIN ITS OCCUPANCY MODE INPUT FROM THE SYSTEM SCHEDULER AS SPECIFIED AND SHOWN. THE SYSTEM SHALL OPERATE IN ONE OF THE FOLLOWING MODES: DAYTIME OCCUPIED, 24/7 OCCUPIED, OR WARM-UP/COOL-DOWN.
FAILURE OF ANY PROOF OR ACTIVATION OF ANY SAFETY SHALL RESULT IN ALL CONTROL LOOPS BEING DISABLED AND THE FAN BEING COMMANDED OFF UNTIL RESET.
3.2.1.3.2 SAFETIES A. PREHEAT COIL DISCHARGE AIR TEMPERATURE LOW LIMIT (FREEZESTAT) (PH-DA-T-LL). B. SUPPLY AIR DUCT PRESSURE HIGH LIMIT (SA-P-HL) C. SUPPLY AIR SMOKE (SA-SMK)

THE DOAH SUPPLY AND DOAH EXHAUST FANS SHALL BE ENABLED (SYS-ENA) AND COMMANDED TO RUN (DOAHSF-SS) AND (DOAHEF-SS). ALL CONTROL LOOPS SHALL BE ENABLED. BOTH SUPPLY AND EXHAUST AIRFLOWS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED AT SCHEDULED MAX AIFLOWS.

THE DOAH SUPPLY AND DOAH EXHAUST FANS SHALL BE ENABLED (SYS-ENA) AND COMMANDED TO RUN (DOAHSF-SS) AND (DOAHEF-SS). ALL CONTROL LOOPS SHALL BE ENABLED. BOTH SUPPLY AND EXHAUST AIRFLOWS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED AT SCHEDULED MIN AIFLOWS.
THE DDC HARDWARE SHALL MODULATE THE SUPPLY FAN VARIABLE FREQUENCY DRIVE UNIT TO MAINTAIN THE SUPPLY AIRFLOW AND EXHAUST AIRFLOW AT SCHEDULED MAX AIRFLOWS (DOAHSA-F) AND (DOAHEA-F).
THE DDC HARDWARE SHALL MODULATE THE SUPPLY FAN VARIABLE FREQUENCY DRIVE UNIT TO MAINTAIN THE SUPPLY AIRFLOW AND EXHAUST AIRFLOW AT SCHEDULED MIN AIRFLOWS (DOAHSA-F) AND (DOAHEA-F).
THE UNIT SHALL BE IN COOLING MODE SHALL WHEN THE OUTDOOR AIR TEMPERATURE IS ABOVE THE DOAH DISCHARGE SETPOINT (DOAHSA-T-SP).
THE ENERGY RECOVERY WHEEL BYPASS DAMPERS SHALL BE OPENED AND THE WHEEL SHALL STOP ROTATING. THE CHW VALVE SHALL MODULATE TO MAINTAIN THE DOAH DISCHARGE TEMPERATURE SETPOINT (DOAHSA-T-SP).
THE UNIT SHALL BE IN HEATING MODE WHEN THE OUTDOOR AIR TEMPERATURE IS BELOW THE DOAH DISCHARGE SETPOINT (DOAHSA-T-SP).
THE ENERGY RECOVERY WHEEL SHALL ROTATE AND THE BYPASS DAMPERS SHALL MODULATE TO MAINTAIN THE DOAH DISCHARGE SETPOINT (DOAHSA-T-SP) WITH THE HHW VALVE CLOSED.

WHEN THE UNIT IS DISABLED AND GLOBAL OA TEMPERATURE SENSOR INDICATES A DRY BULB TEMPERATURE OF LESS THAN 40°F, HHW VALVE SHALL MODULATE TO MAINTAIN A CASING TEMPERATURE OF 40°F AS MEASURED BY THE HEATING COIL LAT TEMPERATURE SENSOR.
THE BUILDING PRESSURIZATION SHALL BE MAINTAINED BY DIFFERENTIAL AIRFLOW BETWEEN OUTSIDE AIR SETPOINTS AND RELIEF AIR SETPOINTS.
UPON RECEIVING A SHUTDOWN SIGNAL FROM ANY EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN SWITCH, DISABLE DOAH AND CLOSE INTAKE AND EXHAUST DAMPERS.
UPON RECIEVING SHUTDOWN FROM FACP, DISABLE DOAH AND CLOSE DOAH OA AND EA INLET AND OUTLET DAMPERS.
UPON RECIEVING SIGNAL FROM DDC DISABLE UNITS UNTIL FAILED CHILLER IS RESTORED TO SERVICE.
